{"subject":"Claim C018952 past filing limit - write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C018952 (patient PT0251, date of service 2026-10-22, service T1019, 9 units, billed $54.90) was submitted 2026-12-29, which is 68 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the claim is predicted to be denied (D03).

Editing the claim cannot fix this. I need a write-off decision on this claim from you. Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, since the claim is already past the filing limit and further delay will not change the outcome.

Thank you."}
